'''Comran''' was an [[Aiel]] who during the [[Breaking]].{{ref/book|c|Comran}} His story is learned from Rand's [[Visions of Rhuidean|visions]] in the ''[[ter'angreal]]'' of Rhuidean.

{{Ancestry/Rand}}

== History ==
Comran was the grandfather of [[Mandein]] and the grandchild of [[Rhodric]].

He found a Ogier ''stedding'' and began trade with them.{{ref/book|4|25}}

==Errata==
He is listed as "a [[Jenn Aiel]] ancestor of Rand" in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but he is both a descendant and ancestor of Aiel that abandoned the [[Way of the Leaf]]. Given the other mislabeling of Jenn Aiel, this is likely an error.{{ref/book|c|Comran}}
